value.rationale: Bucklin is a historically important majority-seeking ranked method and participation is a standard variable-electorate criterion. The classification resolves the entire first tie-independent three-candidate boundary, showing that all failures arise from one threshold-switch mechanism and a three-point normal form rather than from unrelated isolated examples.
